Name: Name
devicesHint: One row per projector. The name becomes the object-tree folder (pjlink-class2.0.<name>.control.power); leave it empty to use the host. Class 1 and Class 2 projectors are detected automatically.
passwordHelp: Used for every projector that asks for PJLink authentication; leave empty if authentication is off
searchHint: Broadcasts a PJLink Class 2 search and adds every projector that answers to the table. Class 1 projectors do not answer and must be added by hand, and broadcasts do not cross routers. Save pending changes first: found projectors are merged into the saved list.
pollIntervalHelp: How often power, input, mute and error status are read
infoIntervalHelp: How often names, inputs, lamp hours and other slow-changing values are read
Listen on UDP 4352 (Class 2 notification: Listen on UDP 4352 (Class 2 notifications and search)
notificationsHelp: Only one program per host can listen on this port
broadcastHelp: Comma separated, e.g. 192.168.254.255 for a directed broadcast to one subnet
